intro: Captain Garran Vimes is sorry to be of little help with the Blackened Iron Shield, but knows who can do better: Caz Twosprocket, one of the best blacksmiths around, who tends the forge in Theramore's smithy.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I'm sorry I can't be of much help, friend, but I can refer you to someone who would be. Caz Twosprocket, one of our best blacksmiths, works the forge at the smithy.
Take the shield to him, and see what he can tell you.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Something for me to look at?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Hm... Interesting piece of iron you have here. Definitely not made by any of the blacksmiths I know over on this side of the sea, and it's certainly not my work.
